title: Bowel obstruction and ileus in the hospital
question: From this hospital discharge summary, assign the ICD-10-CM code for the bowel obstruction or ileus (only that code).
note:
Admission Date: 05/12/2026
Discharge Date: 05/18/2026
Reason for Admission: Acute abdominal pain and vomiting.

Hospital Course:
The patient is a 68-year-old woman who presented to the emergency department with severe abdominal distention and inability to pass gas. Imaging confirmed a complete small bowel obstruction. The clinical team determined that the cause was internal adhesions resulting from a prior abdominal surgery. She was taken to the operating room for a surgical release of adhesions to alleviate the obstruction. Following the procedure, she was managed conservatively with intravenous fluids and enteral nutrition. Her symptoms improved significantly post-operatively. She remained stable for observation and was cleared for discharge once she could tolerate a regular diet and demonstrate adequate bowel function.

Discharge Diagnoses:
- Complete small bowel obstruction
- Adhesions from prior surgery

Discharge Medications:
- Oxycodone 5mg every 6 hours as needed for pain
- Docusate sodium 100mg daily

Follow-up:
The patient will follow up with the general surgery clinic in two weeks for a routine postoperative evaluation.

Electronically signed, L. Moreau, MD, 05/18/2026
explanations: Intestinal adhesions with complete obstruction: K56.52 (HCC 78).
